description: PRD-201 — Destructive Super-Admin Endpoint Removal & CSRF Defence-in-Depth. Delete the leftover one-time template-wipe route, add a reusable same-origin guard + typed confirmation body to destructive super-admin handlers, stop leaking internal operation traces, and close the RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS (_cd + rename) gaps.

userStories.title: Delete the one-time reset-templates wipe route
userStories.description: As an incident responder, I want the leftover 'DELETE AFTER USE' one-time template-wipe route gone so a destructive S3+DB wipe is no longer reachable via GET (prefetch/link-scan/history).
acceptanceCriteria: Delete app/api/super-admin/tenants/reset-templates/route.ts (AC-1); capability retired per OQ-1 (no POST reimplementation unless Gerard requests it)
Removes the GET-reachable destructive wipe and its leaked steps[] trace (AC-2 primary, AC-5)
Nothing imports the route (verified) — no other code references it
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Add security guard module (requireSameOrigin + requireConfirmation)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want reusable defence-in-depth guards so destructive super-admin handlers can reject cross-origin requests and require a typed confirmation token.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/security/require-same-origin.ts exports requireSameOrigin(req): rejects absent/cross-site Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site with 403 + code CROSS_ORIGIN_BLOCKED (AC-4)
lib/security/require-confirmation.ts exports a Zod { confirm } parser that returns 400 + code CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH when confirm does not equal the expected target (AC-3)
Pure functions, no DB/network; usable by any route handler
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Extract + harden RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS (add _cd)
userStories.description: As a tenant, I cannot claim a routing-structural slug like _cd. Extract RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS from the onboarding route into a shared module and add _cd.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/reserved-subdomains.ts exports RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS (incl. _cd), isReservedSubdomain(), and isValidSubdomain() (AC-6)
app/api/onboarding/route.ts imports from the shared module; onboarding behavior unchanged
_cd present in RESERVED_SUBDOMAINS (middleware.ts custom-domain placeholder)
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Enforce reserved + format check on super-admin tenant rename
userStories.description: As a tenant, a super-admin rename of my subdomain re-runs the same validation as create, so I cannot be renamed onto a reserved/invalid slug.
acceptanceCriteria: app/api/super-admin/tenants/[id]/route.ts PATCH validates a changed subdomain via isValidSubdomain + isReservedSubdomain (AC-7)
Reserved/invalid slug rejected with 400 + code RESERVED_SUBDOMAIN before any DB write
Uses the shared lib/reserved-subdomains.ts from US-003
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Apply requireSameOrigin to all destructive super-admin handlers
userStories.description: As an attacker with a cross-site foothold, every destructive super-admin mutation rejects my request on the Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site signal, independent of Clerk SameSite.
acceptanceCriteria: requireSameOrigin guard applied to every destructive super-admin handler (tenant DELETE, template DELETE, cleanup-s3 DELETE, learning DELETE, recover-deleted/migrate-s3-paths/detach POST) (AC-4 100%)
Confirm no destructive (delete/reset/purge) action remains reachable via GET (AC-2)
Guard returns before any mutation/DB/S3 call
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Tenant DELETE: typed confirmation body + stop trace leak
userStories.description: As an operator, the tenant-delete endpoint requires a typed { confirm: <subdomain> } body and never echoes the internal cleanup trace.
acceptanceCriteria: tenants/[id] DELETE requires JSON body { confirm } matching the tenant subdomain via requireConfirmation; mismatch → 400 CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH (AC-3)
Response no longer returns cleanupErrors[]; returns { success, summary: { deleted: n } } with the trace console.error-logged server-side only (AC-5)
Existing audit_logs TENANT_DELETED row preserved (AC-8)
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes

userStories.title: Scope + harden cleanup-s3 (prefix + confirmation + audit)
userStories.description: As an operator, the S3 cleanup route cannot target a bare/over-broad prefix, requires same-origin + typed confirmation, and writes a destructive-action audit line.
acceptanceCriteria: cleanup-s3 rejects bare/over-broad prefixes — requires templates/{slug}/ with a non-empty slug segment and no '..' traversal (AC-1a)
Requires same-origin (US-002) + typed { confirm } matching the slug (AC-3); GET unaffected (route is DELETE-only)
Writes a structured console.error audit line (actor, target prefix, action, timestamp) (AC-8)
Typecheck passes
pnpm build passes
Final story — emit RALPH_COMPLETE
